metadata.abstract: Van der Put and Reversat described the form of a pure q-difference module with non integral slopes. We deduce from this explicit matricial descriptions of the isoformal analytic classes and of the Galois group of pureq-difference modules with non integral slopes. © 2011 Académie des sciences.
